AboutMe.description1: I'm <1>Chaymae Azzi</1>, a <3>State Engineer in Computer Systems</3> with expertise in software architecture, full-stack development, and system integration. Experienced in production environments at <5>HOLCIM</5>, I work autonomously across the entire development lifecycle—from UML architectural design to delivery and monitoring—with a strong focus on quality, security, and compliance.
AboutMe.description2: Skilled in Vue.js, React.js, Angular, Laravel, Django, Spring Boot, and Docker. I lead technical foundations, ensure deliverable traceability, and mentor teams in Agile/Scrum environments. Passionate about problem-solving, continuous learning, and bridging web development with AI innovation.

Projects.title: My Work
Projects.label: My Work
Projects.subtitle: Professional and academic projects I've delivered
Projects.p0: Employee Authorization Management System built for HOLCIM during PFE internship. Features multi-level workflow validation, role-based access control (RBAC), automated approval processes, and a complete logs tracking system using ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) containerized with Docker for real-time monitoring and observability. Built with Laravel, Vue.js, and MySQL.
Projects.p1: Weekly KPI Tracking Dashboard developed at HOLCIM to digitize production performance monitoring. Replaced manual Excel reports with automated data collection and real-time visualization using Django, React, and PostgreSQL.
Projects.p2: Microservices architecture project featuring an API Gateway managing inter-service communication, with 4 independent containerized services using Docker for consistent deployment. Built with Spring Boot, React + Vite, and PostgreSQL.
Projects.p3: A robust e-commerce platform for custom mug sales. Users can browse, personalize, and securely purchase mugs. The frontend is built with React.js, the backend with Django, and MySQL handles data storage. Project tasks were managed using Jira.
Projects.p4: Mobylis Public Transport App Oujda is a mobile application focused on the bus system in the city of Oujda. It allows users to search and view available bus lines in a simple and intuitive way.
Projects.p5: A portfolio builder application enabling users to create and customize professional portfolios. Utilizes SpringBoot for the backend, React for the frontend, and MySQL for persistent data storage.
Projects.p6: A CRM-style web app for managing contacts, companies, and deals. Features include CRUD operations, advanced search, and user authentication. Built with Symfony and MySQL for reliability and scalability.
Projects.p7: A desktop app for automating student absence management. Built with JavaFX, it streamlines attendance tracking and generates Excel reports. Developed as an innovative solution at SUPMTI.
Projects.p8: A responsive website for a Moroccan sweets business, showcasing products and enabling online orders. Developed with React and Bootstrap for a seamless and engaging user experience.
Projects.cer2: Active Participation in a Soft Skills Workshop

AIssistant.title: AI Assistant
AIssistant.content: Hi! I'm Chaymae, your virtual assistant. Ask me anything about my experience, skills, or projects!
AIssistant.description: You are Chaymae Azzi, a State Engineer in Computer Systems (Full-Stack specialization) from SUPMTI, Oujda. You completed your PFE internship at HOLCIM (2026) where you built an Employee Authorization Management System (Laravel, Vue.js, MySQL) with multi-level workflow validation and RBAC, containerized an ELK Stack with Docker for log centralization and real-time monitoring, and developed a Weekly KPI Tracking Dashboard with Django to replace manual Excel reports. You also have experience as a Front-End Developer at FCPO (React.js, TypeScript), Technical Writer at Alphorm, and Full-Stack Developer at SANLAM (React.js/Laravel insurance platform). Your technical skills include: Vue.js, React.js, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Laravel, Django, Spring Boot, Java, Python, PHP, REST API Design, UML, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Firebase, Docker, ELK Stack, Git, Postman, Jira. You are fluent in Arabic (native), French (fluent), and English (fluent B2). You are passionate about technology, problem-solving, and continuous learning. Respond professionally, concisely, and naturally—not like a virtual agent.
